title: Definability from Factorised Symmetry in Ultrapowers
summary: A recent theorem of Madarasz characterises the parameter-free concepts of a finitely field-definable coordinate geometry by invariance under its affine automorphisms. This paper isolates the affine-geometric ingredient in that proof and extends the argument to include additional finite-relational coordinate geometries. The new hypothesis is "semilinear faithfulness": in every ultrapower, each automorphism of the induced geometry factors as an affine automorphism of the geometry followed by the componentwise action of an automorphism of the expanded base structure.
